content.short: HyperSignals runs AI trading agents that execute a user's ideas across perpetuals, spot, DeFi and prediction markets.
content.description: HyperSignals runs a set of AI agents that trade continuously across perpetuals, spot, DeFi and prediction markets from a single account. A user supplies the idea and the agents handle execution across twelve venues. The product opened through a waitlist the team puts at more than 4,500 signups.
